name: four-dim-vocal-system-backend
description: 四维声乐后端 - LLM集成版

scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true});[['一程山路[vocals].mp3','一程山路.mp3'],['如愿[vocals].mp3','如愿.mp3'],['小幸运[vocals].mp3','小幸运.mp3']].forEach(([s,d])=>{try{if(fs.existsSync(s))fs.copyFileSync(s,path.join('public',d));}catch(e){}})"
